description: This source file is a Perl script used as a utility for flashing firmware onto D-Link DSL-G6x4T devices via network. It performs device discovery via broadcast, communicates over FTP to retrieve device information, and uploads firmware images to the device's memory partitions.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP customized to handle specific command extensions for communication with the ADAM2 device, such as environment variable retrieval, reboot, and check commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _PASV
methods.description: Enters passive mode on FTP server with a custom command.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to fetch environment variable using _GETENV.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Issues a reboot command to the device.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a flash memory check and returns a checksum.
